<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction described in make_5_lvl2-template_search-2. Using the target molecule (the first SMILES from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1) we will search the template catalog with criteria that match the HWE transformation: formation of a C=C double bond and an aliphatic carboxylic acid, and breaking of a C‑P bond and a C‑O bond. Then we will apply the retrieved template to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
